input.query: SELECT channel, months_since_activation, n_observable, avg_margin_eur, cac_eur, SUM(avg_margin_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY months_since_activation ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ltv_to_date FROM agg_unit_economics WHERE months_since_activation <= 36 ORDER BY channel, months_since_activation
